videos.script:
Props pass values down. Some components need something else from their parent. Not a value, but a piece of the page. {{slot}} A card, a panel, a dialog. Each is a frame around content it knows nothing about. The hole in the frame is called a slot.

You start with the default slot, its fallback, and a rule about whose variables the content can see. {{named}} Then named slots, for a frame with a header, a body and a footer, and a footer that is not drawn when nobody fills it.

{{scoped}} Then scoped slots. A list component keeps the loop, and lends each item back to the parent, which decides how the item looks.

{{react}} If you have read React code, you have met this already, as a render prop. You will see the two side by side, and a component that renders nothing at all.

{{panel}} And the planner gets one frame for both halves of its screen. An empty week draws the frame's own message, without the planner asking.
